# list of properties of static solutions: # omega: frequency of the scalar field
# M: total mass of the system
# Qe: total charge of the system
# pM: mass in Maxwell field divided by total mass
# pS: mass in scalar field divided by total mass
# QH/Qe: ratio of horizon charge to total charge
# tau_i_X: time it takes for the BH to move a radius that corresponds to X% of the initial distribution of charge in the scalar field
# delta_tau_X: time it takes for the BH to move between a radius corresponding to X% and (1-X)% of the initial distribution of charge in the scalar field
